event_name: SportPesa Racing Point F1 Team Document 46 Date 26 May 2019 Time 18:00 2019 MONACO GRAND PRIX 22 - 26 May 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 18 left the track at turn 10 gaining an advantage.
offence: Breach of Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed on-board and external video and timing data evidence and determined that car 18 left the track without a justifiable reason and gained an advantage. He subsequently took no actions to mitigate this.
rules_referenced: Article 27.3 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 18 Leaving The Track And Gaining An Advantage
